modules.name: Sign Up
modules.req: Guest creates a CUSTOMER account with full name, email, phone and password, or by phone OTP (Firebase) with Complete registration.
modules.pre: Mobile app installed, user is logged out, network available.

cases.desc: Register with valid full name, email, phone and password
cases.proc:
1. Open the app, tap 'Đăng ký'.
2. Enter full name, a new email, a new phone 09xxxxxxxx, password 'Abc@1234' and the same confirmation.
3. Tap 'Đăng ký'.
cases.exp: Toast 'Đăng ký thành công!' (MSG08); account created with role CUSTOMER; user is taken to the customer home page.
cases.pre: Mobile app installed, user is logged out, network available.

cases.desc: Register with an email that already exists
cases.proc:
1. Open the register screen.
2. Enter an email already used by another account and valid other fields.
3. Tap 'Đăng ký'.
cases.exp: Toast 'Email đã tồn tại' (MSG07); no account is created.
cases.pre: An account with the email already exists.

cases.desc: Register with an empty required field
cases.proc:
1. Open the register screen.
2. Leave 'Họ và tên' empty, fill the other fields.
3. Tap 'Đăng ký'.
cases.exp: Inline red message 'Trường này là bắt buộc' (MSG01) under the field; request is not sent.
cases.pre: Mobile app installed, user is logged out, network available.

cases.desc: Register with a wrong email format
cases.proc:
1. Enter email 'abc@' and valid other fields.
2. Tap 'Đăng ký'.
cases.exp: Inline message 'Email không hợp lệ' (MSG02).
cases.pre: Mobile app installed, user is logged out, network available.

cases.desc: Register with an invalid phone number
cases.proc:
1. Enter phone '12345' and valid other fields.
2. Tap 'Đăng ký'.
cases.exp: Inline message 'Nhập số điện thoại hợp lệ' (MSG03).
cases.pre: Mobile app installed, user is logged out, network available.

cases.desc: Register with a password shorter than 6 characters
cases.proc:
1. Enter password '12345' and the same confirmation.
2. Tap 'Đăng ký'.
cases.exp: Inline message 'Mật khẩu phải có ít nhất 6 ký tự' (MSG04).
cases.pre: Mobile app installed, user is logged out, network available.

cases.desc: Register with a confirmation that does not match
cases.proc:
1. Enter password 'Abc@1234' and confirmation 'Abc@12345'.
2. Tap 'Đăng ký'.
cases.exp: Inline message 'Mật khẩu không khớp' (MSG05).
cases.pre: Mobile app installed, user is logged out, network available.

cases.desc: Register by phone OTP and complete the registration
cases.proc:
1. Choose sign in with phone, enter a new phone number.
2. Enter the SMS OTP from Firebase.
3. On 'Hoàn tất đăng ký' enter the full name and confirm.
cases.exp: Firebase ID token is verified on the server; CUSTOMER account with the phone in +84 format is created and the home page opens.
cases.pre: Mobile app installed, user is logged out, network available.

modules.name: Sign In with Password
modules.req: Registered user signs in with email or phone and password; the app opens the home page of the account's role.
modules.pre: Accounts exist for each role (CUSTOMER, LOCKER_TECHNICIAN, DRONE_TECHNICIAN, ADMIN).

cases.desc: Sign in as customer with email and correct password
cases.proc:
1. Open the login screen.
2. Enter the customer email and password.
3. Tap 'Đăng nhập'.
cases.exp: Access and refresh tokens are issued; customer home page is shown.
cases.pre: Accounts exist for each role (CUSTOMER, LOCKER_TECHNICIAN, DRONE_TECHNICIAN, ADMIN).

cases.desc: Sign in with phone number and correct password
cases.proc:
1. Enter the phone number (0xxxxxxxxx) and password.
2. Tap 'Đăng nhập'.
cases.exp: Login succeeds; the phone is matched with the account stored in +84 format.
cases.pre: Accounts exist for each role (CUSTOMER, LOCKER_TECHNICIAN, DRONE_TECHNICIAN, ADMIN).

cases.desc: Sign in with a wrong password
cases.proc:
1. Enter a valid email and a wrong password.
2. Tap 'Đăng nhập'.
cases.exp: Toast 'Thông tin đăng nhập không hợp lệ' (MSG06); no token is issued.
cases.pre: Accounts exist for each role (CUSTOMER, LOCKER_TECHNICIAN, DRONE_TECHNICIAN, ADMIN).

cases.desc: Sign in with an account that does not exist
cases.proc:
1. Enter an unregistered email and any password.
2. Tap 'Đăng nhập'.
cases.exp: Toast 'Thông tin đăng nhập không hợp lệ' (MSG06).
cases.pre: Accounts exist for each role (CUSTOMER, LOCKER_TECHNICIAN, DRONE_TECHNICIAN, ADMIN).

cases.proc:
1. Enter the locker technician credentials.
2. Tap 'Đăng nhập'.
cases.exp: Locker technician home (ticket queue, shift card) is shown.
cases.pre: Accounts exist for each role (CUSTOMER, LOCKER_TECHNICIAN, DRONE_TECHNICIAN, ADMIN).

cases.proc:
1. Enter the drone technician credentials.
2. Tap 'Đăng nhập'.
cases.exp: Drone technician home (dispatch tab) is shown.
cases.pre: Accounts exist for each role (CUSTOMER, LOCKER_TECHNICIAN, DRONE_TECHNICIAN, ADMIN).

cases.desc: Sign in to the mobile app with an ADMIN account
cases.proc:
1. Enter the admin credentials in the mobile app.
2. Tap 'Đăng nhập'.
cases.exp: The app tells the user to use the admin web; no mobile session is opened.
cases.pre: Accounts exist for each role (CUSTOMER, LOCKER_TECHNICIAN, DRONE_TECHNICIAN, ADMIN).

cases.desc: Sign in with a locked account
cases.proc:
1. Enter the credentials of an account locked by the admin.
2. Tap 'Đăng nhập'.
cases.exp: Login is refused with a message that the account is locked.
cases.pre: Admin has locked the account.

modules.name: Sign In with OTP or Google
modules.req: User signs in with phone OTP (Firebase), Google account or email OTP.
modules.pre: Mobile app installed; Firebase phone and Google sign-in configured.

cases.desc: Sign in with phone OTP of an existing account
cases.proc:
1. Choose 'Đăng nhập bằng số điện thoại'.
2. Enter the phone and the received SMS OTP.
cases.exp: Server verifies the Firebase ID token and returns the account; home page by role is shown.
cases.pre: Mobile app installed; Firebase phone and Google sign-in configured.

cases.proc:
1. Enter the phone number.
2. Enter a wrong 6-digit OTP.
cases.exp: Firebase rejects the code; an error is shown and no session is created.
cases.pre: Mobile app installed; Firebase phone and Google sign-in configured.

cases.proc:
1. Tap 'Tiếp tục với Google'.
2. Choose a Google account.
cases.exp: Account with the Google email is signed in (or created as CUSTOMER) and the home page is shown.
cases.pre: Mobile app installed; Firebase phone and Google sign-in configured.

cases.proc:
1. Choose sign in by email OTP and enter the email.
2. Enter the 6-digit code received by email within 300 s.
cases.exp: Login succeeds; the OTP cannot be reused.
cases.pre: Mobile app installed; Firebase phone and Google sign-in configured.

cases.proc:
1. Request an email OTP.
2. Wait more than 300 seconds and enter the code.
cases.exp: Error 'OTP đã hết hạn'; login refused.
cases.pre: Mobile app installed; Firebase phone and Google sign-in configured.

cases.desc: Phone login with an account stored as 0xxxxxxxxx
cases.proc:
1. Use an old account whose phone is stored as 0xxxxxxxxx.
2. Sign in with phone OTP (Firebase returns +84 format).
cases.exp: The existing account is found (both formats are tried); no duplicate account is created.
cases.pre: Old account created before the +84 normalisation.

modules.name: Reset Password
modules.req: User who forgot the password receives an OTP by email, verifies it and sets a new password.
modules.pre: Account with a reachable email exists.

cases.desc: Reset password with a valid OTP
cases.proc:
1. Tap 'Quên mật khẩu', enter the email.
2. Enter the OTP received by email.
3. Enter and confirm a new password.
cases.exp: Password is changed; user can sign in with the new password and not with the old one.
cases.pre: Account with a reachable email exists.

cases.desc: Request reset for an email that is not registered
cases.proc:
1. Tap 'Quên mật khẩu'.
2. Enter an unregistered email and submit.
cases.exp: Generic response; no OTP is sent and no account information is revealed.
cases.pre: Account with a reachable email exists.

cases.proc:
1. Request the OTP.
2. Enter a wrong 6-digit code.
cases.exp: Error message; password is not changed.
cases.pre: Account with a reachable email exists.

cases.proc:
1. Request the OTP.
2. Wait more than 300 s, enter the code.
cases.exp: Error that the OTP has expired; user must request a new one.
cases.pre: Account with a reachable email exists.

cases.proc:
1. Verify the OTP.
2. Enter new password '123'.
cases.exp: Inline message 'Mật khẩu phải có ít nhất 6 ký tự' (MSG04).
cases.pre: Account with a reachable email exists.

cases.desc: Confirmation differs from the new password
cases.proc:
1. Verify the OTP.
2. Enter different new password and confirmation.
cases.exp: Inline message 'Mật khẩu không khớp' (MSG05).
cases.pre: Account with a reachable email exists.

modules.name: Admin Login with 2FA
modules.req: Administrator signs in to the admin web with email + password, then a 6-digit OTP sent by email (max 5 wrong attempts).
modules.pre: Admin web opened in a browser; ADMIN account exists.

cases.desc: Admin login with correct password and OTP
cases.proc:
1. Open the admin web login.
2. Enter admin email and password.
3. Enter the 6-digit OTP received by email.
cases.exp: Dashboard is shown; admin token stored.
cases.pre: Admin web opened in a browser; ADMIN account exists.

cases.proc: 1. Enter admin email and a wrong password.
cases.exp: Error 'Thông tin đăng nhập không hợp lệ'; OTP is not sent.
cases.pre: Admin web opened in a browser; ADMIN account exists.

cases.proc:
1. Pass step 1.
2. Enter a wrong OTP.
cases.exp: Error message with the remaining attempts; still on the OTP step.
cases.pre: Admin web opened in a browser; ADMIN account exists.

cases.proc:
1. Pass step 1.
2. Enter a wrong OTP five times.
cases.exp: The 2FA session is closed; the admin must sign in again.
cases.pre: Admin web opened in a browser; ADMIN account exists.

cases.proc:
1. Pass step 1.
2. Wait more than 600 s, enter the OTP.
cases.exp: Error that the session has expired; back to step 1.
cases.pre: Admin web opened in a browser; ADMIN account exists.

cases.desc: Customer account signs in to the admin web
cases.proc: 1. Enter credentials of a CUSTOMER account on the admin login.
cases.exp: Access refused: only ADMIN can use the admin web.
cases.pre: Admin web opened in a browser; ADMIN account exists.

cases.proc:
1. Sign in.
2. Wait until the access token expires, open another page.
cases.exp: Token is refreshed once silently; admin is not logged out.
cases.pre: Admin web opened in a browser; ADMIN account exists.

modules.name: Kiosk Login by QR
modules.req: Kiosk shows a login QR (expires after 2 minutes); customer scans it in the app and confirms; email OTP on the kiosk as alternative.
modules.pre: Kiosk of a locker is online; customer is logged in on the app.

cases.desc: Log in to the kiosk by scanning the QR
cases.proc:
1. On the kiosk tap 'Đăng nhập'.
2. In the app tap 'Quét QR' and scan the kiosk QR.
3. Confirm in the app.
cases.exp: Kiosk switches to the customer's session (name shown) within a few seconds.
cases.pre: Kiosk of a locker is online; customer is logged in on the app.

cases.desc: Type the session and confirmation codes instead of scanning
cases.proc:
1. In the app choose 'Nhập mã'.
2. Enter the session code and the confirmation code shown on the kiosk.
cases.exp: Kiosk is logged in to the customer's account.
cases.pre: Kiosk of a locker is online; customer is logged in on the app.

cases.proc: 1. Enter the session code and a wrong confirmation code.
cases.exp: Inline message 'Mã chưa đúng. Kiểm tra lại mã phiên và mã xác nhận đang hiện trên kiosk.' (MSG36).
cases.pre: Kiosk of a locker is online; customer is logged in on the app.

cases.proc:
1. Show the QR on the kiosk.
2. Wait more than 2 minutes, then scan.
cases.exp: Kiosk shows 'Mã QR đã hết hạn.' (MSG24); login refused.
cases.pre: Kiosk of a locker is online; customer is logged in on the app.

cases.proc: 1. Request a new QR on the kiosk many times in a short time.
cases.exp: Kiosk shows 'Tạo mã quá nhiều lần. Vui lòng thử lại sau ít phút.' (MSG25).
cases.pre: Kiosk of a locker is online; customer is logged in on the app.

cases.desc: Log in to the kiosk with email OTP
cases.proc:
1. On the kiosk choose email OTP, type the email with the on-screen keyboard.
2. Enter the OTP received.
cases.exp: Kiosk is logged in; a wrong code shows 'Mã OTP không đúng. Vui lòng thử lại.' (MSG26).
cases.pre: Kiosk of a locker is online; customer is logged in on the app.

modules.name: Manage Profile
modules.req: Registered user views and updates personal information and avatar, changes the password and saves the refund bank account.
modules.pre: User is logged in on the mobile app.

cases.proc:
1. Open 'Tài khoản' > 'Thông tin cá nhân'.

cases.exp: Toast 'Cập nhật hồ sơ thành công' (MSG11); new name is shown everywhere.
cases.pre: User is logged in on the mobile app.

cases.proc: 1. Tap the avatar, choose a photo from the gallery.

cases.desc: Change password with the correct current password
cases.proc:

cases.desc: Change password without the current password
cases.proc: 1. Leave the current password empty, enter a new password.

cases.proc:

cases.proc:

modules.name: Search Stores and Lockers
modules.req: Guest or customer searches stores and lockers on the list and on the map, views free boxes and online status, store details and directions.
modules.pre: Stores and lockers exist; location permission granted.

cases.desc: View the store list sorted by distance
cases.proc: 1. Open 'Cửa hàng'.
cases.exp: Stores with lockers are listed with distance from the current position.
cases.pre: Stores and lockers exist; location permission granted.

cases.proc: 1. Type part of a store name in the search box.
cases.exp: Only matching stores are listed; empty result shows an explanatory empty state.
cases.pre: Stores and lockers exist; location permission granted.

cases.desc: Add and remove a favorite store
cases.proc:
1. Tap the heart icon on a store.
2. Open the favorites tab, tap the heart again.
cases.exp: Store is added to then removed from the favorites list.
cases.pre: Stores and lockers exist; location permission granted.

cases.proc:
1. Open a store.
2. Tap 'Chỉ đường' on a locker.
cases.exp: Store detail with photos and lockers; external map opens with the exact locker GPS position.

cases.desc: View lockers on the map with status

cases.exp: Markers show online / offline lockers and the number of free boxes.
cases.pre: Stores and lockers exist; location permission granted.

cases.desc: Offline or MAINTENANCE locker cannot be booked
cases.proc:
1. Open a locker in MAINTENANCE (or offline).

cases.exp: Booking is disabled with a message; no order can be created (BR-20).

cases.desc: Guest searches lockers without signing in
cases.proc:

cases.pre: Stores and lockers exist; location permission granted.

modules.name: Locker Layout Box Map
modules.req: Real box layout of a locker (STANDARD, XL, DRONE) with free / reserved / occupied / fault state; tap an empty box to book.
modules.pre: Locker with boxes of each type and state exists.

cases.desc: Show the real box layout of a locker
cases.proc:
1. Open a locker from the map.
2. Open 'Sơ đồ ô'.
cases.exp: Grid reproduces the physical layout with box numbers and types STANDARD / XL / DRONE.
cases.pre: Locker with boxes of each type and state exists.

cases.proc: 1. Look at boxes AVAILABLE, RESERVED, OCCUPIED, FAULT.

cases.desc: Tap an available box to book it

cases.exp: Send parcel form opens with the box pre-selected.

cases.desc: Tap an occupied or fault box

cases.desc: Layout on a 360 dp wide phone
cases.proc: 1. Open the layout of the largest locker on a small phone.

cases.pre: Locker with boxes of each type and state exists.

cases.proc:

modules.name: Send Parcel
modules.req: Customer chooses the locker and box size (or a box on the map), enters the receiver, applies a voucher / points and creates a SEND order; box is RESERVED with hold time.
modules.pre: Customer is logged in; locker online with free boxes.

cases.desc: Create a SEND order with valid data
cases.proc:
1. Tap 'Gửi hàng', choose locker and box size STANDARD.
2. Enter receiver name, phone and email.
3. Tap 'Tiếp tục'.
cases.exp: Order INITIALIZED with price 15,000 VND (BR-01); box becomes RESERVED; payment screen opens.
cases.pre: Customer is logged in; locker online with free boxes.

cases.desc: Receiver phone has a wrong format
cases.proc:
1. Enter receiver phone '0123'.
2. Tap 'Tiếp tục'.
cases.exp: Inline message 'Nhập số điện thoại hợp lệ' (MSG03).
cases.pre: Customer is logged in; locker online with free boxes.

cases.proc:
1. Leave receiver name empty.
2. Tap 'Tiếp tục'.
cases.exp: Inline message 'Trường này là bắt buộc' (MSG01).
cases.pre: Customer is logged in; locker online with free boxes.

cases.proc: 1. Tap 'Chọn ưu đãi', choose a saved voucher.
cases.exp: Discount is applied and the total is recalculated.
cases.pre: Customer has a valid voucher.

cases.desc: Leave the payment screen of an unpaid order
cases.proc: 1. On the payment screen tap back.
cases.exp: Dialog 'Hủy tạo đơn hàng?' with [Hủy đơn & Thoát] [Ở lại thanh toán] (MSG12); cancelling releases the box.
cases.pre: Customer is logged in; locker online with free boxes.

cases.proc:
1. Create an order and do not pay.
2. Wait 15 minutes.
cases.exp: Order becomes CANCELED and the box is released (BR-03).
cases.pre: Customer is logged in; locker online with free boxes.

cases.desc: No free box of the chosen size
cases.proc:
1. Choose a locker whose XL boxes are all taken.
2. Choose size XL.
cases.exp: Message that no box of this size is free; order is not created.
cases.pre: Customer is logged in; locker online with free boxes.

cases.desc: Pickup PIN is unique among active orders
cases.proc:
1. Create many SEND orders at the same locker.
2. Compare the 6-digit PINs of all active orders.
cases.exp: Every active order must have a different PIN.
cases.pre: Many active orders exist.
cases.note: Defect F2-G10: no unique index on the PIN of active orders (Pending).

modules.name: Pay by VietQR SePay
modules.req: Checkout by bank transfer: server generates VietQR with the order code in the transfer content; the SePay webhook marks the order PAID only when the full amount is received.
modules.pre: Customer has an INITIALIZED order; SePay is the enabled payment method.

cases.desc: Generate the VietQR for an order
cases.proc: 1. On the payment screen choose 'Chuyển khoản (VietQR)'.
cases.exp: QR with bank account, amount and order code in the content is shown; 'Mở app ngân hàng' opens the bank app pre-filled.
cases.pre: Customer has an INITIALIZED order; SePay is the enabled payment method.

cases.proc:
1. Transfer the exact amount with the order code.
2. Wait for the SePay webhook.
cases.exp: Payment PAID, order PAID; app moves to the drop step automatically.
cases.pre: Customer has an INITIALIZED order; SePay is the enabled payment method.

cases.proc: 1. Transfer an amount lower than the total.
cases.exp: Received amount is recorded; order stays unpaid until the money covers the total (BR-02).
cases.pre: Customer has an INITIALIZED order; SePay is the enabled payment method.

cases.desc: Webhook received twice for the same transfer
cases.proc: 1. Replay the same SePay webhook.
cases.exp: Second webhook is ignored (idempotent); the order is not paid twice.
cases.pre: Customer has an INITIALIZED order; SePay is the enabled payment method.

cases.desc: Money arrives after the order was cancelled
cases.proc:
1. Let an order be cancelled.
2. Transfer the amount afterwards.
cases.exp: Order is not revived; the late money goes to refund (REFUND_PENDING).
cases.pre: Customer has an INITIALIZED order; SePay is the enabled payment method.

cases.desc: Simulate a transfer in test mode
cases.proc:
1. Admin turns test mode on.
2. Tap 'Giả lập thanh toán' on the VietQR screen.
cases.exp: Order becomes PAID; the button is hidden when test mode is off.
cases.pre: Customer has an INITIALIZED order; SePay is the enabled payment method.

cases.desc: Pay with a disabled method through the API
cases.proc: 1. Call checkout with method MOMO.
cases.exp: Error PAYMENT_METHOD_UNSUPPORTED (MSG31).
cases.pre: Customer has an INITIALIZED order; SePay is the enabled payment method.

modules.name: Pay with Loyalty Points
modules.req: Customer pays part of an order with loyalty points (1 point = 1 VND, at least 1,000 points, at most 50 % of the order after vouchers) and the rest by VietQR.
modules.pre: Customer logged in and has loyalty points.

cases.desc: Pay the rest by VietQR after redeeming points
cases.proc:
1. Turn on 'Dùng điểm', enter 2,000.
2. Pay the remaining amount by VietQR.
cases.exp: Order PAID after the SePay webhook confirms the remaining amount; 2,000 points debited.
cases.pre: Customer logged in and has loyalty points.

cases.proc: 1. Turn on 'Dùng điểm', enter 1,000.
cases.exp: Total reduced by 1,000 VND; points debited on payment.
cases.pre: Customer logged in and has loyalty points.

cases.proc: 1. Enter 500 points.
cases.exp: Error: at least 1,000 points (BR-18).
cases.pre: Customer logged in and has loyalty points.

cases.desc: Redeem more than 50 % of the order
cases.proc: 1. Enter points greater than half of the order after voucher.
cases.exp: Points are capped at 50 % of the order (BR-18).
cases.pre: Customer logged in and has loyalty points.

cases.desc: Points returned when a paid order is cancelled
cases.proc:
1. Pay with points.
2. Cancel / refund the order.
cases.exp: Points and voucher usage are returned (BR-18).
cases.pre: Customer logged in and has loyalty points.

modules.name: Drop Parcel and Share Code

cases.desc: Open the box with the send code on the kiosk
cases.proc: 1. On the kiosk choose 'Gửi hàng', type the send code.
cases.exp: Box opens; drop is confirmed on the kiosk.
cases.pre: SEND order is PAID; sender is at the locker.

cases.desc: Try to open the box of an unpaid order
cases.proc: 1. Call open on an INITIALIZED order.
cases.exp: Error ORDER_UNPAID (MSG30); box stays closed.
cases.pre: SEND order is PAID; sender is at the locker.

cases.proc: 1. Confirm the drop.
cases.exp: Receiver receives the 6-digit PIN by email and SMS; receiver with an account also gets a notification.
